rules: Final A/B public source uses the exact registered original public config and current source capsule, with only source_review_store replaced by a fresh integration-owned store. Compiled claims must be byte-equivalent as structured values before and after; original stores and public gates remain unchanged. Only source-method evaluation rows enter this separate source coverage.

Canonical initial I public judgments remain sealed independent historical review, without rebinding old public captures against final workspaces. No historical/native freshness is inferred; this common initial comparison is outside final-delivery and final-source-coverage denominators. I private uses the exact registered canonical initial config.

Private I/A/B source and image binding and finish use the unchanged frozen independent_native_v3 runner, exact registered private configs and original native outcome/capture/cycle pins. No new native sample. Missing/invalid actual evidence remains U and raw failed material is retained.

Each final public source-only operation is supervised with the unchanged native envelope/meter and uses original frozen A/B evaluator bytes. Original profile admission, whole current source capsule and tool/config/contract pins are verified separately. No multi-action batching or new device acquisition.

All post-seal binding/review costs are separate from original public source-window cost; this common isolation/helper work is not a treatment benefit. Portable source-responsibility and source-domain evaluation remain unsupported after archive cleanup.
